Nav Menu

Nav menus provide structured lists of navigation links that can be laid out horizontally or vertically, with support for icons, dividers, headers, badges, and active states.

A nav menu is a list of navigation links. Use .zak-nav-menu-horizontal to lay the links out inline for top-level navigation; omit it for a vertical list suitable for sidebars. The component works with plain links, icons, badges, grouped headers, and divisional separators.

Horizontal Nav Menu

A standard horizontal menu for top-level navigation.

  • Home
  • Products
  • Resources
  • Pricing
  • Contact
HTML
<nav class="zak-nav-menu zak-nav-menu-horizontal" aria-label="Horizontal navigation">
    <ul class="zak-nav-menu-list">
        <li class="zak-nav-menu-item"><a href="#" class="zak-nav-menu-link active">Home</a></li>
        <li class="zak-nav-menu-item"><a href="#" class="zak-nav-menu-link">Products</a></li>
        <li class="zak-nav-menu-item"><a href="#" class="zak-nav-menu-link">Resources</a></li>
        <li class="zak-nav-menu-item"><a href="#" class="zak-nav-menu-link">Pricing</a></li>
    </ul>
</nav>

CSS Classes

Nav menu styles are controlled through these CSS classes.

HTML
/* Menu Container */
.zak-nav-menu                   /* Base vertical nav menu */
.zak-nav-menu-horizontal        /* Horizontal layout */

/* Menu Parts */
.zak-nav-menu-list              /* List container */
.zak-nav-menu-item              /* List item wrapper */

/* Links */
.zak-nav-menu-link              /* Menu link */
.zak-nav-menu-link.active       /* Active/current state */

/* Sections */
.zak-nav-menu-header            /* Section header label */
.zak-nav-menu-divider           /* Visual separator line */

/* Nested / Subnav */
.zak-nav-menu-subnav            /* Nested nav item wrapper */
.zak-nav-menu-subnav-toggle     /* Toggle button for subnav */
.zak-nav-menu-subnav-list       /* Nested list container */
.zak-nav-menu-subnav.open       /* Expanded subnav state */

/* Extras */
.zak-menu-shortcut              /* Keyboard shortcut hint */

JavaScript

Handle active link state changes with JavaScript.

HTML
// Handle navigation menu clicks
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-nav-menu-link').forEach(link => {
    link.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        e.preventDefault();
        // Remove active from siblings
        this.closest('.zak-nav-menu-list').querySelectorAll('.zak-nav-menu-link').forEach(l => {
            l.classList.remove('active');
        });
        // Set active on clicked
        this.classList.add('active');
    });
});

// Toggle subnavs
document.querySelectorAll('.zak-nav-menu-subnav-toggle').forEach(toggle => {
    toggle.addEventListener('click', function() {
        const subnav = this.closest('.zak-nav-menu-subnav');
        const isOpen = subnav.classList.contains('open');
        subnav.parentElement.querySelectorAll('.zak-nav-menu-subnav.open').forEach(s => {
            if (s !== subnav) s.classList.remove('open');
        });
        if (!isOpen) subnav.classList.add('open');
    });
});

Keyboard Navigation

Support keyboard navigation with Tab and arrow keys inside the menu list.

HTML
var list = document.querySelector('.zak-nav-menu-list');
var links = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('.zak-nav-menu-link'));
var index = -1;
list.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'ArrowDown') { e.preventDefault(); index = Math.min(index + 1, links.length - 1); links[index].focus(); }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowUp') { e.preventDefault(); index = Math.max(index - 1, 0); links[index].focus(); }
    if (e.key === 'Home') { e.preventDefault(); index = 0; links[index].focus(); }
    if (e.key === 'End') { e.preventDefault(); index = links.length - 1; links[index].focus(); }
});

Accessibility

Follow these accessibility best practices when using nav menus.

  • Use <nav> element with aria-label to identify the menu purpose.
  • Mark the active link with aria-current="page" or aria-current="true".
  • Use proper list semantics (<ul>, <li>) for screen reader navigation.
  • Ensure dividers use role="separator" for accessibility.
  • Headers should be semantically marked or use role="heading".
  • Support keyboard navigation with Tab and arrow keys.
HTML
<nav class="zak-nav-menu zak-nav-menu-horizontal" aria-label="Main navigation">
    <ul class="zak-nav-menu-list">
        <li class="zak-nav-menu-item">
            <a href="#" class="zak-nav-menu-link active" aria-current="page">Home</a>
        </li>
        <li class="zak-nav-menu-item">
            <a href="#" class="zak-nav-menu-link">Products</a>
        </li>
    </ul>
</nav>
